subject: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps (reserved GPUs, SLA targets)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Collins <jared.collins@acmehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps (reserved GPUs, SLA targets)

Hi Jared / Priya —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap of what we heard and the recommended next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Pain points you called out:
- High variability in inference latency during peak ETL windows impacting user-facing features.
- Strict data isolation and audit requirements for PHI workflows.
- Need predictable per-token costs for budgeting across Q3/Q4.

Goals on your side:
- Dedicated GPU capacity with network isolation (VPC) and SOC2 evidence.
- Scale to handle peak concurrency of ~450 concurrent sessions and average throughput of 60 QPS across prompt sizes.
- SLA target: 99.9% uptime and p95 text-generation latency under 250ms for typical prompts.

Redwood recommended configuration (initial proposal):
- Dedicated capacity: 8 x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved (Dedicated tier) with burst pool to 12 GPUs for peak spikes.
- Isolation: Private VPC deployment with customer-managed subnet and KMS integration for key management.
- Scaling plan: autoscaling policy to add burst nodes at 70% capacity, cooldown 2 minutes; warm pools for commonly used model shards to keep cold-starts under 200ms.
- Observability & SLOs: per-route dashboards, token-level cost breakdown; SLA monitoring and monthly reporting.

Procurement / timeline notes:
- Typical lead time for Dedicated private deployment with onboarding and security review: 4–6 weeks after contract signature.
- We'll provide a mutual action plan and SOC2 checklist (attached) to speed the security review.

Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx, SOC2-questions.pdf

Next steps (proposed):
1) Confirm that the recommended capacity (8 reserved GPUs, burst to 12) matches your performance targets.
2) Introduce procurement + security (send contact info) and share the MAP/SOC2 items for their review.
3) Schedule a follow-up 30-minute call next week to review pricing and onboarding timeline — I’m available Tue/Wed morning PT.

If this looks right, I’ll draft the SOW and include a 30-day SLA credit clause per our standard Dedicated terms and circulate to procurement.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
